body:
My dear friend,

Welcome home! The valley has missed you.

Do you remember the very first letter I ever sent you? We planted beans together. It's spring again, and the garden is ready. Shall we plant a new row?
summary: Plant a new row of beans with Miss Miriam.
done: A new row, ready to grow!

from the jug in your kitchen
